Oracle taps investors for US$20 billion to finance AI expansion

Oracle plans to raise US$20 billion (HK$156 billion) through bond and share sales, regulatory filings showed on Monday, as the software giant taps investors to fund its costly AI and cloud infrastructure build-out.

External source The Standard 英文虎報 2 Nov 2026, 7:37 pm 1 min brief
